Based on patterns from 40+ produced videos. **The core insight: Video Agent is an HTML interpreter.** It renders layouts, typography, and structured content natively. Describe B-roll as layered text motion graphics with action verbs ("slams in," "types on," "counts up") — not layout specs ("upper-left, 48pt"). ## Reference Files | File | Load when... | |------|-------------|
